turns.patient_opening: Hi. I’ve had a fever and a cough, and my throat is really painful—both my tonsils hurt, and my palate and pharynx feel sore too. I also have hoarseness, and the pain is about 7 out of 10. I had a cold about two weeks ago, and I work at a daycare, so I’m around a lot of people.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had diarrhea or an increase in how often you’re having bowel movements?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had diarrhea or increased bowel movements.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a high-pitched sound when you breathe in (like a whistling or squeaky sound)?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any whistling or squeaky sound when I breathe in.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have a burning type of pain? (Yes or no)
